name: @matatbread/matbot-function-runner-node
description: Node-only FunctionRunner: runs a tool_function body with its synchronous stretches bounded, the globals that reach a capability withheld, and its import(...) routed through the caller's gate. Optional — without it a body runs unbounded, unshadowed and ungated.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
